Sends each item out of the port of the first rule it passes, each rule a test like If's; the items no rule takes leave from other.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `logic.switch` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `other`, and one per row of **Rules** (`rules`), named by its **Port** (`port`) |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rules (`rules`) | table, its columns below | no |  | A row each, tried in order: the port it sends to, and its test. Each port shows on the node. |

### Rules columns

Each row of **Rules** has these cells. Its rows name ports, so it takes no expression: the ports must be known when the workflow is saved.

| Column | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Port (`port`) | text | yes |  | The output port the items this rule takes leave from. |
| Field (`field`) | text | yes |  | The item field to test. |
| Test (`operator`) | text | no | `gt` | One of `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `eq`, `neq`, `is`, `isNot`, `contains`, `notContains`, `exists`, `missing`. |
| Value (`value`) | text or a number | no |  | A number for the comparisons, text for is and contains (any case). Not used by exists and missing. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
